title: glandularia lambertii
intro: Glandularia lambertii, commonly known as Rosy Verbena or Marsh Verbena, is a perennial herb native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its potential to alleviate anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Glandularia lambertii are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and carminative effects, which are due to the presence of bioactive constituents like volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to fully understand the plant's medicinal properties and potential applications, but it is already used in some traditional medicine practices for its calming and digestive benefits.
